issue_request: FHIR-28415 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core datatypes. It reported that Duration drt-1 said a code is required when a value is present, but the FHIRPath expression only constrained instances when code was present.
initial_application: Commit 0fa9bbb48c1eb0f222045bc1f95b20b217e47894 applied the fix to source/datatypes/duration.xml on R4B-related history, and R4B generated history contains the corrected expression. That commit is not an ancestor of the current reconciliation branch, where the active Duration spreadsheet still had the old expression.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps datatype spreadsheets into the active build via [types] and *=datatypes. FHIR-47129 later repeats the same R6 mismatch and says FHIR-28415 had only been updated for R4B; it was not separately decided because it is Resolved - change required. FHIR-34465 confirms examples were affected by the corrected drt-1 rule, and the current PackagedProductDefinition example includes value, unit, system, and code.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/duration.xml so Duration drt-1 uses value.exists() implies ((system = %ucum) and code.exists()).
source_changes: source/datatypes/duration.xml: changed the Duration drt-1 FHIRPath expression from code.exists() implies ((system = %ucum) and value.exists()) to value.exists() implies ((system = %ucum) and code.exists()).
